incidence_definition: A binary minimum word/four-cycle is incident with a ternary K3,3 witness exactly when its four quotient-line vertices are contained in the six quotient-line vertices of that induced K3,3.
association_falsifier: The partition of pairs solely by number of shared Levi edges is not an association scheme: for the shared-one-edge relation, A_1^2 has three different values 30,31,36 on adjacent pairs in that same relation.
theorem: The suggestive 1080=3*360 count is promoted to an explicit objectwise incidence theorem: every binary Levi minimum four-cycle lies in exactly three induced K3,3 ternary homology witnesses, and every induced K3,3 contains exactly nine binary minimum four-cycles. The resulting 1080-by-360 incidence graph is connected and has exact modular ranks 324,359,360,360 over F2,F3,F5,F7.
boundary: The 360 K3,3 objects are the canonical ternary projective weight-6 witnesses of Pass4808, not asserted to exhaust the full ternary minimum quotient shell.
